description: Three rounds of the [[7,1,3]] 6.6.6 colour code as a Z memory, read out in the program; every ion reset; then three rounds as an X memory, read out by the grader (10 ions: 7 data, 3 ancillas, reset and reused every round). The circuit is the off-the-hook schedule with one auxiliary per plaquette (circuit distance 2, arXiv:2603.28852). Goal 3 fixes this code and compares architectures by the time per round and the logical error rate per round (a round fails when either memory does) under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
